descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As the Senior Solution Architect, you will be the key responsible for the SAP Solution Manager 7.2 ecosystem. You are responsible for the end-to-end "Requirements to Deploy" (R2D) framework, ensuring that all SAP changes—from global templates to local rollouts—are governed, tested, and deployed with zero disruption. You will lead the configuration, maintenance and optimization of Focused Build and ChaRM to support high-velocity Agile delivery in a complex, multi-track S/4HANA landscapes. Description of the area Senior Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools. Responsible for the strategic design and operational excellence of all ERP specific ALM capabilities related to the end to end process "Requirements to Deploy", incl. and not limited to Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.
• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.
• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes.
• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within a defined Solution Context.
• Business / Technical ability: Applies general and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas. Contributes minimally but effectively to Architecture Practices development and mentoring. Qualifications
• ALM Toolset Mastery: 8+ years of hands-on experience with SAP Solution Manager (Focused Build, ChaRM, Solution Documentation, Test Management, Project management), SAP Cloud ALM, Adonis, and Worksoft.
• Release Management: Deep expertise in ERP change management, hybrid environments on CTS, CTS+, cTMS, transport layers, conflict analysis, and downgrade protection.
• Lifecycle Leadership: Proven track record of managing 2–3 full-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles in a global corporate setting with strong stakeholder management skills.
• System Configuration: Extensive experience configuring and adapting SAP Solution Manager to meet complex business needs.
• Process Standards: Strong
